The '''Hatawa sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], bordering [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]]. The [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] overlapped the two sectors. Planets in the sector included [[The Marais/Legends|The Marais]].
